title: Three Months and One Short Notice
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：park　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 park 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the warden ① openned the park that no resident in the centre would have recorded, and he said the openning was the whole of the month. The ② park, meaning the garden itself and not the notice, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a park, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ park in that centre had the same short notice beside it, and the ④ park at the far gate, meaning the form they kept for the children to fill in and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A park, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the warden said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the park was the whole of the matter, meaning the leisure and not the garden. The ⑥ park, meaning the leisure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; park, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a garden and a leisure. He said the leisure is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ park had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short notice. The ⑧ park of the whole thing, the warden wrote in June, was one centre and three months of recording; park, he said, is either the form at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ park I remember is the garden recorded in the register, which closed in 2001 and is still recorded as the quietest in the centre. A ⑩ park, my mother said in 2003, is the only garden that improves by being recorded; every park, she said, is a leisure that has agreed to look like a garden. She said the leisure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 公园（指社区中心里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 公园（指那座公园本身，与小小的告示相对）
C. 固定搭配：open the park 开放这一座公园
D. n. 公园（指留给孩子们填的那一张）
E. n. 公园之事（抽象总称，指一处社区中心的公园之事）
F. n. 公园（指登记册里写到、被记载的那一座）
G. n. 公园、闲情（指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 闲情（抽象总称，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: openned the park that no resident in the centre would have recorded
The park, meaning the garden itself and not the notice
the park at the far gate
the park was the whole of the matter
the park had become a line in a register
The park of the whole thing

answers.why: open the park 意为“开放这一座公园”，1994 年那位管理员把社区中心里没有一位居民肯记载的一座公园做了一遍。
park 意为“公园”，指那座公园本身而不是小小的告示，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
park 意为“公园”，指社区中心里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一张小小的告示。
park 意为“公园”，指最远那道大门的留给孩子们填的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
park 意为“公园、闲情”，指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这座闲情就是那件事的全部。
park 意为“闲情”，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座公园，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
park 意为“公园”，指登记册里写到、被记载的那一座，到 1999 年这一座成了登记册里的一行。
park 意为“公园之事”，管理员六月写道，整件事的公园之事是一处社区中心和三个月份的记载。
park 意为“公园”，我记得的是登记册里记载过的那一座，2001 年办妥了，至今仍被说成社区中心里最安静的一座。
park 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，公园是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的公园。
